subject: Sherwood pilot: success metrics & trial roadmap
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Miller <evan.miller@sherwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Sherwood: follow-up + proposed trial success criteria

Evan — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we spin up the pilot environment.

Recap (30-min discovery):
- Primary goal: Replace current inference pipeline for document extraction and Q&A with a low-latency candidate that can be served in production (mix of streaming and sync calls).
- Key constraints: 95th-percentile latency target, < $0.008 cost/token at scale, ability to handle bursts to ~180 qps, and maintain existing precision/recall on entity extraction.

Proposed Pilot (3 weeks, gated):
1) Success metrics (gating):
   - Latency: p95 <= 250 ms for 512-token prompts (single-request path) under production-like load; p50 <= 120 ms.
   - Throughput: sustain 140 qps steady-state, tolerate bursts to 180 qps for up to 30s with graceful degradation.
   - Cost: unit cost <= $0.008 / token (inference only) using Redwood batching + KV caching recommendations.
   - Quality: entity-extraction F1 drop <= 2% vs baseline test set; top-1 answer accuracy >= 93% for the verification set.
   - Reliability: error rate <= 0.5% and end-to-end success on 99.5% of sampled requests.

2) Evaluation plan:
   - We will run 3 synthetic load profiles (baseline, 2x, burst) + 2 real workload samples you provide (dev and prod sample).
   - We'll produce a short evaluation report with latency heatmaps, cost-per-1M-token projection, and quality regression checks.

3) Ownership:
   - Redwood: infra setup, model variant onboarding, baseline benchmarks, and a first-pass cost projection (Priyom + Ben).
   - Sherwood: provide representative workload samples, baseline test sets for quality comparison, and an internal contact for procurement (Evan).
   - Ops contact: Monica will be primary for runbook and alert handoffs.

4) Timeline (tentative):
   - Week 0 (setup): sign pilot SOW, infra access (VPC peering / API keys), dataset exchange.
   - Week 1: baseline benchmarks and initial tuning; first pass latency/cost numbers.
   - Week 2: tuning + quality validation; run burst profiles.
   - Week 3: final readout + decision (go/no-go, scale recommendations).

Attachments: attached a one-page scope (sherwood_poc_scope_v1.pdf) and initial latency benchmark export to illustrate expected reporting.

Immediate asks: can you confirm the pilot SOW approver and the two sample datasets we discussed (dev-sample.csv, prod-sample.csv)? If we can get those by EOD Thu (9/17) we can target a Mon 9/20 start.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

From: Evan Miller <evan.miller@sherwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sherwood: follow-up + proposed trial success criteria

Thanks Priyom — this is a great summary and aligns with what we discussed. A couple notes from our side: 

- Approver for SOW: our Head of AI Ops (Lily Chen) will need a 1-pager and budget estimate; I'll loop her into procurement once we have the SOW draft.
- Datasets: I'll share dev-sample.csv and prod-sample.csv (anonymized) by EOD Thursday as requested.
- Quick question on cost projection: does the $0.008/token include the cache hit assumptions you mentioned, or is that raw inference?

I'll plan for a tentative kickoff on Mon 9/20 assuming we get the SOW and datasets in place.

— Evan
Evan Miller
Director, Data Science — Sherwood AI
evan.miller@sherwood.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Miller <evan.miller@sherwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sherwood: follow-up + proposed trial success criteria

Evan — quick follow-up from the Redwood ops side with clarifications and a small ask so we can keep the Monday start date: 

Clarifications on cost: the $0.008/token projection assumes a 25% effective cache hit rate on prefix tokens and the use of recommended batching. We'll run a sensitivity table in the baseline benchmark (attached: latency-benchmark.csv). If you want a conservative raw-inference number (no cache), we can provide that too.

Action items (owners + deadlines):
- Sherwood: share datasets (dev-sample.csv, prod-sample.csv) — Evan — by 2026-09-17 EOD.
- Sherwood: confirm SOW approver contact and budget ceiling — Evan — by 2026-09-17 EOD.
- Redwood: draft SOW and pilot runbook — Priyom — by 2026-09-17 EOD.
- Redwood: baseline benchmark and first-pass cost table — Ben — target 2026-09-22.

Runbook note: during the pilot we will instrument detailed latency percentiles, per-route token costing, and a small quality regression harness that will run nightly against the provided verification set. Monica will be the on-call for alerts during load runs (pager handoff details in SOW).

If those owners and dates work, we'll prepare the SOW for Lily's review (Evan to confirm).

Monica Patel
Principal, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai

From: Evan Miller <evan.miller@sherwood.ai>

Please proceed with SOW and infra steps — Evan will introduce Lily on the SOW email thread once the draft is ready.
